name: giims-student-portal
description: A web-based student admission and fee-management portal for GIIMS, built with Django, PostgreSQL, HTMX, and Alpine.js.

scripts.build:js: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('static/dist/js', { recursive: true }); fs.copyFileSync('node_modules/htmx.org/dist/htmx.min.js', 'static/dist/js/htmx.min.js'); fs.copyFileSync('node_modules/alpinejs/dist/cdn.min.js', 'static/dist/js/alpine.min.js'); console.log('HTMX and Alpine.js copied to static/dist/js/');"
scripts.build: npm run build:js && npm run build:css
